Answers to your questions

We’ve gathered the most popular questions to make it easier for you to understand the service.

Who can become a nurse on the Onlayn Hamshira platform?

Medical specialists with a diploma and at least 3 years of work experience. Qualification verification is mandatory.

How does the registration process work?

Download the app, register using your phone number, and go through a short interview with our manager.

How is the income calculated?

You receive payment directly from the client, and a portion is transferred to the app as a commission — similar to Yandex.Taxi.

Are there mandatory shifts or a schedule?

No. You work at a time that is convenient for you and choose orders in the app.
